integrity: Self-contained analytical proof; a companion finite Python computation was run from its current package path and corroborates selected numerical values. Independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
limitations: The result gives expected polygon vertex counts, not full distributions, for Haar center-passing planes only. Does not concern randomly offset sections, nonregular prisms, or n=3,4. Older stereological texts were not fully accessible; historical priority is provisional.
scientific_scope: Haar-uniform central planar sections of right regular n-gonal prisms for all integers n>=5 and all normalized positive half-heights h; expectation, unique five-gon height maximizer, and asymptotic six-gon threshold.
title: A pentagonal optimum and a hexagonal threshold for mean central sections of regular prisms
